title: What is Darwinism?
author: Charles Hodge

authorInfo.bio: Charles Hodge (1797–1878) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "What is Darwinism?" by Charles Hodge is a scientific publication written in the late 19th century. The book critically examines the concept of Darwinism and its implications, especially regarding the existence of God and the origins of life.
